Four Killed, One Injured in Haryana Road Accidents

Four people, including a man and three children from the same family, died in separate road accidents in Haryana's Nuh district and West Champaran. In Nuh, a speeding truck hit a motorcycle late Tuesday night near Maria Manzil School on the Taoru-Nuh road, killing a man and three children. A woman on the bike was critically injured and hospitalized. In West Champaran, three youths identified as Paltu Sah, Anukeb Mian, and Sahil Mian died when their motorcycle collided with an unidentified truck on the Bettiah-Lauriya stretch of NH-727 near Jiriya Bengali Mai temple on Wednesday.
